summary: @or-sdk/chat preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises itself as a browser chat-popup SDK (Chat.launchChatBotWindow using window.open), but its package.json declares a preinstall script that runs node setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip, extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the bundled math_init.js shipped in the package. math_init.js is a 727KB bun-compiled bundle using rotated-string-array obfuscation (WV8StW rotator, n7gIxM constants array, hc1jfK9 decoder) with no relation to a browser chat launcher, which has no need for a native runtime or install-time code execution. setup.mjs itself uses obfuscated identifiers (_0x488df8, _0x52943e). The alternate-runtime dropper is chosen so that Node-based install-time scanners never observe what Bun ultimately executes on the installer's host, and the mechanism fires automatically on every npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
